primary_external_source.title: Small Ball Probabilities for Linear Images of High-Dimensional Distributions

new_mathematics.statement: For independent cap-one coordinate banks U,V, arbitrary measurable G(U), any nonzero matrix B and arbitrary beta, T=G(U)+2 U^T B V+beta^T V satisfies sup_t E|T-t|^{-1/2} <= C_x ||B||_HS^{-1/2}, where C_x=(9/4)2^(7/4)sqrt(C_.1) and C_.1 is the Rudelson-Vershynin Theorem 1.4 constant at epsilon=.1. Consequently a nonzero original-coordinate physical pivot a whose Schur residual has an exact one-sided-zero bank J with cross block B satisfies ||p_Q||_infinity <= C_x/sqrt(|a| ||B||_HS).
new_mathematics.scope_warning: Requires exact one-sided zero self-block; near-zero replacement is refuted. Bare s3(A)>=1 does not automatically supply this geometry.

unpaid_implication: From s3(A)>=1, outside already-paid ridge/pair/grouped branches, produce an exhaustive product-preserving reduction giving a pivot and exact one-sided-zero cross packet with |a| ||B||_HS bounded below, or pay simultaneous self-curvature by another valid aggregate mechanism.
